elections.title: Cricket World Cup 2027

questions.q: Winner in {India, Australia, South Africa, England}

flags: 13 months to resolution - the engine's instruments are at their weakest this far out; expect WATCH on anything sharp.
Instruments openly disagree on England: the market makes them 3rd favourite (7.0) while ICC ratings rank them 8th. That divergence is the product, not a bug.
Bookmaker odds snapshot is undated; Manifold is thin (~1.8k traded). Market instrument is low-grade and treated as such.
Model is championship-share by rating, not a tournament simulation - format (14 teams, SA/Zim/Namibia, Oct-Nov 2027) not yet modeled.

Market instrument prices only 4 teams, so its probability for any wider set (e.g. 'top 8') is a FLOOR, not an estimate - the true market number is higher. Gate verdicts are unaffected (floor only makes the gate more conservative).

tripwires.watch: Major books publish dated outrights (closer to tournament)
ICC ratings shift 5+ points for any contender
Tournament draw/format announced

rules: Winner = team awarded the trophy per ICC official result, including a final decided by DLS or a super over
Shared trophy (final abandoned with no reserve-day result): every 'X wins' question resolves YES for each co-champion; set-membership questions resolve YES if any co-champion is in the set
'Winner from current ICC top 8' resolves against the eight teams named in the question's entity list at freeze (2026-10-22 ratings), not the ratings at tournament time
Tournament cancelled or not completed with no trophy awarded = VOID, logged and excluded from scoring
resolution.source: ICC official result of the Cricket World Cup 2027 final (icc-cricket.com), expected 2027-11

instruments.market_source: OLBG bookmaker outrights (undated, 2026) averaged with Manifold prediction market (~1.8k traded)
instruments.model_note: P(champion) proportional to exp(rating/tau), tau=8 rating points (stated prior, not fitted); hosts South Africa get +3 rating home bonus (stated prior)

elections.title: Premier League Winner 2026-27
flags: THE DISAGREEMENT, DECODED (2026-10-23): the market favours Arsenal while our table model favours City - and it is not just stale odds. Polymarket prices a City POINTS DEDUCTION by June 2027 at 74.5% (charges verdict pending). Our model simulates the table as it stands and cannot see sanction risk; the market can. Until the verdict, the title race is genuinely open and this forecast stays WATCH.
Market odds (2026-10-20) predate MW8, where City lost at Villa and Arsenal drew level on points (both 21 at MD8); the model sees the MD8 table the market has not priced. Timing gap noted 2026-10-26.

Model simulates teams independently vs average opposition - no fixture list, no injuries, no schedule strength. It is a deliberate coarse instrument; 7 games of evidence get heavy regression to the mean.
Reference point (not an instrument): Opta supercomputer after MD5 had Arsenal 43.7%, City 39.8%.

A title stripped retroactively AFTER first confirmation of the final table does not change resolution

flags: NEW-ENTRANT FLAG ACTIVE: Waris Punjab De (Amritpal Singh) polls 8.5-14% with no electoral baseline - the exact TVK/TN2026 pattern. All would-be CALLs are suppressed to WATCH-FLAG per the validated N=46 rule.
All final-window polls are unrated agencies; two partisan-affiliated polls (Desh Ka Verdict/INC, Aapka Opinion/AAP) excluded - seat-only projections, no vote shares.

nef.evidence: polling 8.5-14% (SCORE 8.5, People's Pulse 14) with zero presence in PB2022 baseline and GE2024; satisfies the N=46 rule 'serious contender invisible to both baseline AE and prior GE'. TN2026/TVK precedent: all CALLs suppressed to WATCH-FLAG.

A rated agency (CVoter/CSDS/Axis) publishes a vote-share poll

rules: Bloc seat totals = sum of seats won by the member parties listed in `blocs` as composed at freeze; post-result defections, mergers and letters of support are ignored
If an alliance splits BEFORE polling, a re-run forecast (new ledger rows) supersedes; these rows still resolve against freeze-time bloc composition
'wins majority' = bloc seats >= 59 of 117 at first full declaration; countermanded/postponed seats count as not won unless they decide the question, in which case resolution waits for them
'is largest' = strictly more seats than every other modeled bloc (independents and unmodeled parties are not blocs); an exact tie resolves NO for all blocs
Seat-threshold questions resolve on the same official tally
If the election is not held by 2027-12-31, rows resolve VOID: logged and excluded from scoring, never silently dropped

rules: Bloc seat totals = sum of seats won by the member parties listed in `blocs` as composed at freeze; post-result defections, mergers and letters of support are ignored
If an alliance splits BEFORE polling, a re-run forecast (new ledger rows) supersedes; these rows still resolve against freeze-time bloc composition
'wins majority' = bloc seats >= 202 of 403 at first full declaration; countermanded/postponed seats count as not won unless they decide the question, in which case resolution waits for them
'is largest' = strictly more seats than every other modeled bloc (independents and unmodeled parties are not blocs); an exact tie resolves NO for all blocs
Seat-threshold questions (e.g. 'BSP under 25 seats') resolve on the same official tally
If the election is not held by 2027-12-31, rows resolve VOID: logged and excluded from scoring, never silently dropped

elections.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
flags: Resolves in 10 days - the fastest real-world test the world engine will get.
Senate model is the race-level correlated Monte Carlo roll-up (USMIDRACES2026, scripts/usmid_races.py): 35 structural per-seat probits with one shared national error term. Candidate-blind by design.
Model tipping-point (+2.5) is taken from published redistricting analyses, not fitted by us.

tripwires.watch: Generic-ballot average moves 3+ points before Nov 3

tripwires.effect: re-run; dual gate may become decidable
tripwires.watch: Polymarket House price crosses 0.95 either way

rules: House majority = party holding >= 218 of 435 seats per final certified results, NOT election-night leads; uncalled races resolve by their eventual certified winner
Senate majority = party controlling the floor at seating, with independents counted toward the party they caucus with (caucusing rule); a 50-50 Senate resolves to the Vice President's party
Rows resolve early, before 2027-01-03, if and when AP-called races put control beyond arithmetic dispute
A seat vacant at seating (death/resignation after certification) counts for the party that won it
Recounts and litigation: resolution waits for certified outcomes; no row resolves on a contested margin
resolution.source: Official state certifications as aggregated by Associated Press race calls; control counted at the seating of the 120th Congress (2027-01-03)

instruments.model_note: Silver Bulletin average D+9.1 (2026-10-23); prior D+8.9 (10-07); Pew D+8 (10-10), Reuters/Ipsos D+12 (10-20) consistent
